_about: H. B. Swete’s footnotes to his printed text: the readings of the manuscripts of the Psalms of Solomon, which Swete (vol. III preface) cites by the small letters of the minuscules: c, h, i, l, m, p, r, v. "at" is the verse where a page’s footnotes stand in the digital text, usually at the end of the page they belong to; the verse numbers are inside each note, and a page the digital text lacks has none.
